text: Discipline positioning: It belongs to the category of engineering, with the first-level discipline code 0809. It has core directions such as microelectronics science and engineering, electronic information materials and devices, and optoelectronic technology science. During the undergraduate stage, students are admitted to the "Electronic Science and Technology" major, focusing on basic theories and device design. During the postgraduate stage, the directions are further specialized, such as integrated circuit design, nanoelectronics, and optical communication devices.Core objective: Through researching the movement laws of electrons (including photons and quanta) in materials and devices, designing and manufacturing electronic devices with specific functions (such as chips, sensors, lasers), and constructing electronic systems based on these devices, to solve the underlying problem of "how hardware is implemented" in the field of information technology, and support the research and application of various electronic devices.
